pages.title: Getting started
pages.summary: Start Pantry on your own computer in two lines, sign in as the owner and finish setup.

pages.title: Your first month
pages.summary: The five setup steps on Overview, from the business details to your first close.

pages.title: Sales and bills
pages.summary: Draft, approve and issue invoices and credits, record bills with their receipts, and record payments.

pages.title: Bank feeds and rules
pages.summary: Connect your bank and cards once, choose where each account goes, and let your rules file the routine transactions.

pages.title: Receipts
pages.summary: Take a photo or forward the email; Pantry reads the vendor, date and total and attaches it to the right transaction when you accept.

pages.title: Reconcile a bank statement
pages.summary: Import a CSV or OFX statement, match each line to your books, and finish when the difference is $0.00.

pages.title: Journals and corrections
pages.summary: Prepare a balanced entry, have someone else post it, and correct a posted entry with a reversal.

pages.title: Reports, cash or accrual
pages.summary: Open any figure to its records, switch between cash and accrual, report sales tax by state and track 1099 contractors.

pages.title: Close the month
pages.summary: Pass the checklist, finish the review tasks, lock the month and download the accountant package.

pages.title: Agent work
pages.summary: Give the agent you already use a token; it proposes matches and entries and a person approves each one.

pages.title: People and roles
pages.summary: Owner, bookkeeper, accountant and viewer, the post, lock and reopen grants, and who may approve what.

pages.title: Move in from QuickBooks Online
pages.summary: Preview seven QuickBooks Online exports and their tie-outs, import them as staged records, and sign them off.

pages.title: Back up and restore
pages.summary: Export the whole book to one archive and restore it into an empty installation.
